1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __1500__ Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __different__ multivalent cation crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __a polyalkylenimine selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine and polypropylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other__ anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, wherein the concentration of said crosslinker is __less than 10% by weight__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium __, calcium, or barium__ ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has an average particle size of about 200 to 900 nm in diameter__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle __capable of entrapping__ a multivalent cation.

14) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle for delivery of an oil and gas chemical to a reservoir, said composition comprising a polyethylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion intimately associated with an oil and gas field chemical to form a polyelectrolyte complex, said complex having an average particle size of less than __500 nm__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that is crosslinkable with a multivalent cation__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide __with a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __selected from the group consisting of brine, seawater, or freshwater__.
